faq.q: How much does Koch Law charge?
faq.a: Koch Law publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Koch Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Koch Law does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Koch Law have offices?
faq.a: Koch Law publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Koch Law?
faq.a: Koch Law names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Koch Law?
faq.a: Koch Law scores 41 and sits at Listed. Passed: entity registration and footprint. Did not pass: website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.

json_ld_descriptions:
Koch Law, PLLC understands that being accused of a crime or an immigration issue can impact your future and the future of your loved ones. Criminal charges or immigration issues can result in a criminal record upon conviction or removal from the United States, both of which have significant consequences on career and growth opportunities for you and your loved ones. To protect your future, our priority is to get your case criminal dismissed or lawful immigration status.

At Koch Law, we pride ourselves in thinking outside the box to earn the best results for our clients. Our approach enables us to strategize and handle each case with a strong and customized defense.

As a veteran of the United States Air Force, I hold the same core values of Integrity first, Service before self, and Excellence in all we do as I did when I served. My training and expertise were in handling highly sensitive matters, computer systems, and developing technology to complete my mission. My Clients First, Justice Always approach to handling cases means I will be there for you when you need me the most. With the same dedication and commitment upheld in the Air Force, I provide steadfast legal representation. Drawing on extensive knowledge of criminal law, I vigorously defend clients against serious charges while also guiding individuals through the intricate immigration process.
